assertions.title: Blocked section is the canonical normalized-blocked callout

steps.action: Open the dashboard in overview state and inspect the summary, goal cards, and table rows.
steps.expected: A dedicated blocked section appears whenever the active subset contains normalized blocked rows.
steps.observed: Overview showed multiple rows labeled 'At risk', but the summary still read 0 Blocked and no blocked section appeared anywhere on the page.

steps.action: Capture an overview screenshot after the page settles.
steps.expected: The canonical blocked callout is visible in overview.
steps.observed: The screenshot only shows summary, goal cards, controls, and the table; the blocked section is absent.

assertions.issues: The dedicated blocked section never rendered even though overview rows included visible 'At risk' items.

assertions.title: Blocked section responds to active scope and filters

steps.action: Scope the dashboard to goal 2 using the goal card.
steps.expected: The blocked section updates to only show blocked rows from the scoped subset.
steps.observed: The table narrowed to 41 goal-2 updates containing several 'At risk' rows, but no blocked section appeared.

steps.action: Return to overview and capture both scoped and unscoped states.
steps.expected: Blocked visibility changes coherently with the active subset.
steps.observed: Neither the overview nor the scoped state showed any blocked section.

evidence.consoleErrors: browser-console-final.txt shows repeated 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_INVALID_URL' messages.

assertions.title: Fully complete goals do not surface blocked callouts

steps.action: Click the 100%-complete goal 2 card to confirm it remains explorable.
steps.expected: The complete goal card can still be scoped without adding blocked callouts.
steps.observed: Goal 2 scoped successfully at 100% (6/6 DONE), remained interactive, and still showed no blocked callout.

steps.observed: All goal cards showed progress and stale labels, but none displayed blocked counts or blocked-owner names despite visible 'At risk' rows in the active overview.

assertions.title: Freshness reflects sheet-update recency rather than fetch time

steps.action: Review the top-level freshness indicator in overview after the data loads.
steps.expected: The header freshness communicates recency from the underlying sheet data and aligns with stale treatment when updates are older than 7 days.
steps.observed: The header remained 'Live · update date unavailable' while all goal cards simultaneously showed 'Stale (> 7d)'.

steps.action: Reload the page and compare the freshness messaging again.
steps.expected: Reloading should not mask stale data as current or unavailable when dated rows are present.
steps.observed: The mismatch persisted across reloads; the header freshness never reflected the dated row recency.

assertions.title: Escape unwinds state in priority order

steps.action: Activate goal scope and press Escape.
steps.expected: Escape clears the active scope first.
steps.observed: After Escape, overview totals and the full 101-row table returned, but the stale 'Scoped to goal' banner remained visible instead of clearing cleanly.

steps.action: Reload, expand the first row, and press Escape.
steps.expected: With no scope active, Escape closes the expanded row.
steps.observed: The row details remained visible after Escape, so the expanded row did not close.

steps.action: Reload, open the filter panel, and press Escape.
steps.expected: With no scope or row expansion active, Escape closes the filter panel.
steps.observed: The filter controls still remained visible after Escape, so the panel did not close.

assertions.issues: Escape does not unwind state in the required priority order; it leaves stale scope UI, open row details, and visible filter controls behind.
